## Purpose
The first agent decision. It turns the raw query into a structured `RequirementSpec` that every later layer reads instead of the query.

## Responsibilities
- **Allowed enum values:**
  - `_TASK_TYPES`: lookup, analysis, generation, transformation, conversation;
  - `_COMPLEXITY`: simple, moderate, complex;
  - `_MODALITY`: text, image, mixed.
- **Coercion helpers:**
  - `_one_of(value, allowed, default)` lowercases the value and falls back to the default;
  - `_str_list` turns a string into a one-item list, keeps only non-empty items, and returns `[]` for anything else.
- **`RequirementAnalysisLayer`:** `name="requirement_analysis"`, `label="Understand the request"`, `phase="requirement analysis"`, status "Understanding what you need…".
- **`build_prompt`:** `REQUIREMENT_ANALYSIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT`, and the user prompt formatted with `user_query` and `image_note`. The image note, when an image is attached, is "The request includes an attached image. Treat the modality as 'image' or 'mixed' and account for visual content in the deliverable.".
- **`apply`:**
  - builds the `RequirementSpec`:
    - `intent` is at most 1000 chars and defaults to the query;
    - `task_type` defaults to conversation, and `domain` to "general" (at most 200 chars);
    - `deliverable` is at most 1000 chars;
    - `complexity` defaults to moderate;
    - `modality` defaults to image when an image is attached, otherwise text;
    - the five `needs_*` booleans;
    - the lists `success_criteria`, `constraints`, `risk_factors` and `unknowns`;
  - an attached image with modality text is forced to mixed;
  - sets `ctx.requirements` and `rationale["requirements"]`;
  - emits `requirements` with intent, task_type, domain, deliverable, complexity, success_criteria, risk_factors and reasoning.
- **`fallback`:** `RequirementSpec(intent=query, task_type="conversation", domain="general", deliverable="A helpful, accurate answer to the request.", complexity="moderate", modality="mixed" if image else "text")`.

## Key elements
`RequirementAnalysisLayer`, `_one_of`, `_str_list`.

## Control flow
The `AgentDecisionLayer` flow.

## Data, state and side effects
One LLM call. Emits SSE.

## Configuration
The default decision tier.

## Interactions
- **Prompts:** `app.prompts_decisions`.
- **Read by:** nearly every later agent layer, through `ctx.requirements` and `_requirements_block`.

## Error handling and edge cases
The fallback always produces a spec, so later layers never need to check for None.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **`_str_list` guards against a bare string.** A layer iterating a string goes character by character.
- **The image fact overrides the model.** The model does not always notice the attachment.
